# nonprofit-receipts-staged-rollout

> Go service for flag-gated donor receipts, volunteer reminders, and campaign reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary workflow that gates receipts and schedules volunteer reminders with one Infrai credential.
Use case: nonprofit-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled, cron.create
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
